_comment: THE SECOND ROUND OF THE VERDICT WORKLIST, 21 September 2026.
Twelve edges the first round could not be ruled on from what the file carried.
SEVEN WERE FILED WITH NO SENTENCE AT ALL. D-14 mapped the 98 `framework_agreement`
edges to firmness `framework` en bloc and re-read none of them, so their
`firmness_basis` was the ruling that mapped them and not anything a publisher
wrote. A ruling is not a sentence to verdict on. All seven have now been re-read
and carry the sentence their source actually states; dep_records' citation gate
checks each one against the cached page.
FIVE WERE RULED `unclear` BY THE READER, each with a reason that named what the
filed sentence did not say. Each source has been re-read for the sentence that
states the agreement or the order, and that sentence is in `sentence_on_reread`
below. FIRMNESS IS UNTOUCHED on all five: the re-read says what the document says
and the reader says what it means.
`copy_on_file` says whether the bytes this sentence was read from are the artefact
the cache index records or a later re-read of the same address (dep_restore.py).
The citation gate rules only on the first kind.

ruled unclear: understated — the pilot has been operating at Dunkirk since April 2023 and the filed sentence is the result, not the relationship
edges.sentence_on_reread: (1) Coordinated by IFPEN, the “3D” project brings together other 10 partners from research and industry from 6 European countries: ArcelorMittal, Axens, TotalEnergies, Air Products, Brevik Engineering, John Cockerill, DTU, Gassco, ETHZ and Uetikon.
edges.what_the_re_read_found: NO SENTENCE IN THIS SOURCE STATES AN AGREEMENT OR AN ORDER. The release reports a test result. The only sentence that states the relationship at all is the consortium footnote above: Axens is one of eleven partners in a Horizon 2020 project, which is what the edge already rests on. If the reader wants a supply sentence for this row it is not in this document and a different one has to be found.

edges.why: ruled unclear: "selected to supply" is a selection, not an order
edges.sentence_on_reread: (Midrex) and Primetals have been selected to supply a hydrogen direct reduced iron (DRI) plant for Blastr Green Steel (Blastr), one of the largest industry start-ups in the Nordic region.
edges.what_the_re_read_found: THE FILED SENTENCE IS THE ONLY ONE THERE IS. The whole release is the selection; it carries no contract, no order, no value and no delivery date. The reader's doubt is the document's own state.

edges.why: ruled unclear: the excerpt does not state the 700 MW order itself
edges.sentence_on_reread: thyssenkrupp nucera partners with H2 Green Steel in constructing the first large-scale green steel plant in Europe.
edges.what_the_re_read_found: NEITHER DOES THE REST OF THE PAGE. The headline says thyssenkrupp nucera "Supplies the Electrolyzers" and the body states a partnership and a capacity — "an installed capacity of more than 700 MW" — and never an order, a contract or an award. The 700 MW is what the modules will enable, not what was bought.

edges.why: ruled unclear: "Selects MIDREX Flex" is a technology selection; the plant contract went to the engineering contractor
edges.sentence_on_reread: Midrex Technologies, Inc. and Paul Wurth will partner to engineer, supply, and construct a 2.5 million tons/year MIDREX Flex™ direct reduction plant for thyssenkrupp Steel Europe AG at its Duisburg, Germany, site.
edges.what_the_re_read_found: THE BODY SAYS MORE THAN THE HEADLINE. The reader ruled on the headline, which is a selection; the first sentence of the release has Midrex and Paul Wurth partnering to engineer, supply and construct the plant, with its capacity and its site.

edges.why: ruled unclear: the filed sentence is a permit statement, not a supply statement
edges.sentence_on_reread: The contract for the construction of a direct reduction plant plus two smelters awarded to the SMS group in consortium with Midrex Technologies, Inc. in spring 2023, was the largest single order in TKS history and launched one of the largest industrial decarbonization projects worldwide.
edges.what_the_re_read_found: THE SUPPLY SENTENCE IS IN THE BACKGROUND PARAGRAPH, below the permit news the reader was shown: the contract was awarded to SMS group in consortium with Midrex in spring 2023 and is called the largest single order in TKS history. It names the award, the parties and the scope; it is dated to a season, not a day.
